author: designer
label: sprint
prompt:
ACTION: a road cyclist in black wins a bunch sprint on a grand tour finishing straight, beating a rider in a yellow leader's jersey and a rider in a white jersey with rainbow chest stripes by half a wheel, then sits up and raises both arms.

THE RIDER (same in every shot): late twenties, dark stubble, metallic dark-blue aero helmet, violet mirrored wraparound sunglasses, black jersey with a black-and-white block pattern on the left sleeve, black bib shorts, black socks, matte black bike, deep carbon wheels, tan-wall tyres.

SHOT 1 (0-4 s): low tracking shot ahead of the bunch, 35mm lens. Twenty riders in tight formation; the rider in black sits third wheel behind yellow and rainbow, then swings right into open road. Whip pan right into shot 2.

SHOT 2 (4-8 s): side tracking shot at hip height, 50mm lens. The three sprint shoulder to shoulder out of the saddle, bikes rocking; the rider in black edges ahead. Fast push into the front wheels into shot 3.

SHOT 3 (8-12 s): frontal shot from behind the finish line, 85mm lens, slight slow motion. All three throw their bikes at the white line; the black bike crosses first. He sits up, arms wide, shouting with joy.

PLACE: sunny finishing straight in a southern French town, dark asphalt, barriers packed with flag-waving spectators, plane trees, finish gantry overhead.
LIGHT: hard late-afternoon sun from camera-left, long shadows, reflections on helmets and carbon.
SOUND: crowd roar building to the line, whirring freewheels, tyres humming, the crowd erupting at the finish.

lint.msg: 257 words. Long prompts bury the action; keep it under ~150 and lead with what happens.
